prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1102; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by the third-party vehicle. Claimant reports knee pain on the driver side and was transported to a local clinic by ambulance. Police report requested; scene photos received from insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports left knee pain, swelling, and difficulty bearing weight since the impact. Claimant states they have not retained an attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly. Explained the claims process, the documentation needed, and that they may seek independent advice at any time. Medical authorization form sent.

Entry 3: Received clinic records. Diagnosis indicates a soft tissue injury to the left knee with a recommendation for imaging and physical therapy. No fracture noted on initial X-ray. Claimant confirmed attendance at follow-up appointment. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect expected medical treatment.

Entry 4: Third-party carrier acknowledged liability for the rear-end impact. Claimant contacted to confirm current symptoms and treatment schedule. Claimant reports ongoing knee stiffness and missed two days of work. Wage verification form sent to employer. Claimant asked general questions about the settlement process; answered factually without offering legal opinion.

Entry 5: Physical therapy progress notes received and reviewed. Claimant is improving and expects to return to full activity within the next several weeks. Medical bills and wage documentation are being compiled for final evaluation. Claimant reminded to submit any outstanding receipts. File remains open pending final treatment update.
